text:
Maya (Finance): Quick heads-up — mid‑year ops budget refresh landed. Small procurement policy tweaks and a temporary vendor exception flow for urgent GCP work. TL;DR below.

Alex (Eng): tl;dr? :eyes:

Maya (Finance): TL;DR: 1) Card / single‑invoice approval bumped to $5k (temporary, through Sep 30). 2) New GCP vendor exception path for quota/patching outages. 3) Contractors/integrators still need a PO for > $2k. 4) Receipts + purpose required for client meals even on cards.

Jordan (ProdOps): Is the $5k bump retroactive to invoices submitted this week? We had a rental machine charged yesterday.

Maya (Finance): Yes — applies to invoices dated >= today. If you already submitted, please add comment "ops-emergency" in the invoice portal so we can fast-track.

Rajat (Purchasing): New exception flow (short):
```
1) Submit the GCP Vendor Exception form: https://intranet/redwood/finance/gcp-exception
2) In the form add: project ID, estimated spend, reason (quota/patch/incident), proposed approver (tag @Priya).
3) Purchasing reviews within 2 business hours; Finance gives final sign-off for spends <= $5k. >$5k goes to Director review.
```

Priya (Finance Partner): Note — provide a one-paragraph justification and attach the cost estimate from the vendor portal. Missing docs will push you back in the queue.

Alex (Eng): For machine rentals (short term), do we need both PO + exception? or exception alone covers it?

Rajat (Purchasing): Exception alone covers ad‑hoc infra rentals up to $5k while finance runs PO in parallel. If >$5k, please open a standard PO request and reference the exception ID.

approvals-bot: New exception request #3421 queued for review (submitted by alex.kim). ETA: ~1h. Attachments: gcp-quotas.pdf

Alex (Eng): Thanks — adding the quote now.

Maya (Finance): A couple of operational notes: 1) This $5k bump is temporary — we'll reassess at end of quarter. 2) No change to Enterprise vendor onboarding — that still requires full vendor packet and security review. 3) We're rolling out a 15‑min finance office hours on Fridays for procurement questions.

Jordan (ProdOps): Can finance share a short checklist we can paste into runbooks?

Maya (Finance): Yep — will drop a one‑pager to #docs and link in the intranet page. Also running a 20‑min Q&A Friday 10:00am PT.

Alex (Eng): Appreciated — makes emergency infra less painful. :+1:

Maya (Finance): If you have active vendor exceptions, ping me or @Rajat directly. We'll prioritize anything impacting customer availability.

Rajat (Purchasing): Filing note: tag exceptions with `ops-emergency` and LA/NY region in the form so we route to the right procurement lead.

Priya (Finance Partner): Reminder: still need itemized receipts for meals (card or personal) for client entertainment — company card only allowed if you pre-clear on the form.

Maya (Finance): Thanks everyone — posting summary + links to the intranet in a follow-up message. Please forward any developer questions to the Friday session or ping me directly.
